dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 29, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Thrilling Upsets and Dominant Performances**

The Miami Marlins stunned the Philadelphia Phillies 8-6, with Griffin Conine delivering a pivotal home run and Tyler Zuber securing the win. The Arizona Diamondbacks dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-0, thanks in large part to Eduardo Rodriguez's eight scoreless innings. In a tight matchup, the Atlanta Braves took down the New York Mets 1-0, with Chris Sale striking out nine and Matt Olson providing the game's only run.

On the other side of the spectrum, the San Francisco Giants crushed the Milwaukee Brewers 16-3, with Daniel Susac hitting two home runs and Logan Webb pitching six strong innings. The Texas Rangers fell 3-0 to the Tampa Bay Rays, with MacKenzie Gore throwing seven scoreless frames. The San Diego Padres edged the Colorado Rockies 3-1, with Griffin Canning shutting down the Rockies' offense.
